faqData.question: What time should I arrive?
faqData.answer: Guest gathering begins at 3:30 PM. Please arrive on time so everyone can be seated before the 4:00 PM ceremony.

faqData.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faqData.answer: As our wedding is intimate with limited capacity, we can only accommodate guests named on the invitation. Thank you for understanding.

faqData.question: Where is the venue?
faqData.answer: The celebration will be held at Tierra Kuta Resort in Sta Cruz Alitagtag, Santa Teresita, Batangas, Philippines. You may find directions through the map link on this invitation.

faqData.question: What is the dress code?
faqData.answer: Please wear warm, elegant tones. Kindly reserve white for the bride only.

faqData.question: Will there be food and drinks?
faqData.answer: Yes — snacks will be served at 5:00 PM, with the program continuing into the evening. Come ready to celebrate with us!

faqData.question: Are gifts expected?
faqData.answer: Your presence is the greatest blessing. As we will be building our life in Canada, we kindly ask for no wrapped or boxed gifts. If you wish to bless us further, a monetary gift in cash or through e-money would be most appreciated — you may leave an envelope during the wedding dance, or send a gift using the QR code on this invitation.
